Subject: ONE mature adult Black woman in her early 40s with clearly adult facial features, a high bun with a carved bone pin, warm confident smile.

Background & Lighting: A bright pale warm-sand stylized background, lighter than her body, warm light from the side she faces, deep cel-shaded shadows under each belly roll and along the curve of her rear, the black glaze gleaming, glossy anime highlights on every curve. 2:3 vertical full-body illustration.
